source_name: Gal et al. (2001) Figure 2a, Sodankyla full-sky imaging polarimetry
description: Digitized full-sky degree-of-linear-polarization reference from the 2 h panel of Figure 2a in Gal et al. (2001), measured at 450 nm with calibrated full-sky imaging polarimetry.

geometry.relative_azimuth_definition: bearing from the solar direction in the published fisheye map

notes: This is a digitized coarse full-sky DoLP field derived from a published calibrated fisheye map, not raw instrument output.
The published circular map was sampled assuming approximately linear zenith radius in the rendered figure.
The reference is low-sun daytime sky at solar zenith 83.1 deg, not below-horizon twilight.
Only polarization metrics are enforced for this case because the source figure does not provide a matching calibrated intensity table.
